required_promotion_gates: A written e=8 analogue of Lemma 4 deriving the exact Stark normalization from the ordinary complex absolute-value convention
An exact orientation procedure that enumerates and uniquely resolves all eight root-of-unity multiples
An independent Q(sqrt(-3)) imaginary-base reconstruction identifying the same oriented packet
identification.arb_gate_order: The Arb Shintani/cocycle enclosure may run only after all three gates pass.

e8_protocol.normalization_target: With |x|_w=|x|_ordinary^2 and e=8, the 2/e factor is 1/4; the exact character/Fourier convention must be derived in the written analogue before use.
e8_protocol.orientation_target: Enumerate zeta_8^j times the candidate for j=0,...,7 and require one exact Artin-phase/normal-closure identity to select exactly one.
e8_protocol.second_base_target: The Q(sqrt(-3)) route must independently recover the same packet and orientation, not merely an isomorphic normal closure.

boundary: All field, conductor, character, Stark-hypothesis, and unit-lattice claims are exact. The equality between the differenced invariant and the displayed candidate unit is not claimed. In particular, an Arb enclosure alone cannot promote the case until the three e=8 gates are discharged.
